description: Each subject may carry dob, nationality, entity_type, id_number and your reference. Identical rows are screened once (charged once). Returns per-subject decision_hint, hit_count, top_score and the top 5 hits, plus summary counts (clear / review / likely_match). Charged per unique name. Example: subjects [{name:'Ali Kony', reference:'C-17'}, {name:'شركة الأمل للتجارة', entity_type:'entity'}], default_nationality 'AE'. Response: result plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[] (official list pages), data_version (snapshot id), warnings[] (e.g. a list snapshot older than 7 days) and a disclaimer. Lists: ofac_sdn, ofac_cons, un, eu, uk, uae. Names are never logged; matching is deterministic (no AI) and runs offline against the bundled snapshot.

dob.description: Date of birth 'YYYY', 'YYYY-MM' or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Year match adds, mismatch subtracts; omit if unknown.
dob.title: Dob

entity_type.description: individual | entity | vessel | aircraft | any (default). Disagreement with the listed type costs 20 points.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

id_number.description: Passport / national ID / registration number. An exact match on a listed number is reported as 'exact' (score 100).
id_number.title: Id Number

name.description: Full name, Latin or Arabic script.
name.title: Name

nationality.description: Nationality / country of incorporation as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ('AE', 'IR', 'GB'). Omit if unknown.
nationality.title: Nationality

reference.description: Your own row id / customer reference, echoed back.
reference.title: Reference

default_nationality.description: ISO2 applied to rows without a nationality.
default_nationality.title: Default Nationality

lists.description: Subset of lists to screen (default all): ofac_sdn, ofac_cons, un, eu, uk, uae.
lists.title: Lists

min_score.description: Minimum score (0–100) for a hit to be returned; default 85. 80 widens the net for onboarding, 92 for alert review.
min_score.title: Min Score

subjects.description: Up to 500 subjects (name + optional dob / nationality / entity_type / id_number / reference). Identical rows are screened once.
subjects.title: Subjects

name: screen_batch
title: Screen up to 500 names in one call
